selection.title: 布雷开始
selection.revision_brief: 布雷开始：机械保险拨开、投放滑轨拉动的准备动作；不包含实际爆炸。

feedback_history.notes: 不是海军布雷，是机械厂开关

production.prompt: A heavy spherical naval sea mine starts rolling from a shipboard deployment cradle toward the stern chute over the ocean. A short weighty rounded metal roll, low chain payout and a brief downward air movement. About one second, marine equipment carrying a heavy object. No factory switch, door latch, motor drone, explosion or impact in water yet. Clear compact attack, dry and precisely separated stages. Isolated finished game sound effect, no speech or vocals, no background ambience.

asset_design.title: 布雷开始
asset_design.direction: 低沉重物滚向投放口＋短链条放出，随向下空气感结束；重物和方向主导，保险开关不作主体。 验收：应是有重量的布雷准备/投放动作；开始事件不提前伪造水雷完成。
